title.en: When a power plant reaches its legal limit, what keeps the grid ready?
title.zh: 电厂用尽获准时数后，电网如何备战？

summary.en: A DOE renewal issued November 17 and effective November 18 lets oil-fired Wagner Unit 4 operate conditionally beyond its annual hours limit through December 31, with settlement, reporting and environmental conditions.
summary.zh: 11月17日续发、18日生效的能源部命令，让燃油瓦格纳四号机组可有条件超出年度时数限制，期限至12月31日，保留和解、报告与环境条件。
